title: 💸 Moonshot Cancels a $150 Million Chip Deal with Nvidia!
body: 💸 Moonshot Cancels a $150 Million Chip Deal with Nvidia!

Chinese AI company Moonshot, developer of the Kimi models, cancelled a $150 million deal to rent Nvidia’s most powerful “Blackwell Ultra B300” chips from a data center in Indonesia. The decision came after a new US rule took effect on November 19, requiring data centers to obtain a license if they provide large computing capacity to Chinese companies, even if the chips are outside China. The company had paid half the deal’s value in advance — double the usual share — and later signed an alternative agreement with another cloud provider in Southeast Asia.
Simply put: America banned selling advanced chips to China directly, so Chinese companies turned to renting them from data centers in other countries; and the new rule closed that door too.
Do you think the chip war affects how fast AI develops?
